_readme: Edit this file to change what the site pulls. google_news entries are Google News RSS searches (query syntax = Google News search), always run with the U.S. edition (gl=US). google_alerts entries are RSS URLs from google.com/alerts (create an alert, Show options, Deliver to: RSS feed, then copy the feed link). Lines starting with # are ignored. Stories about other countries are filtered out by scripts/fetch_news.py.

google_news.name: Data center announced
google_news.query: "data center" (announces OR announced OR plans OR proposed OR unveils) when:7d

google_news.name: Data center construction
google_news.query: "data center" (construction OR "breaks ground" OR groundbreaking OR opens) when:7d

google_news.name: AI and hyperscale
google_news.query: ("AI data center" OR "hyperscale data center" OR "data center campus") when:7d

google_news.name: Data center power
google_news.query: "data center" (power OR grid OR megawatt OR gigawatt OR nuclear OR utility) when:7d

google_news.name: Data center policy
google_news.query: "data center" (zoning OR council OR moratorium OR residents OR "tax breaks") when:7d

google_news.name: U.S. grid operators
google_news.query: "data center" (ERCOT OR PJM OR MISO OR FERC OR "Southwest Power Pool") when:7d

google_news.name: Local approvals
google_news.query: "data center" (county OR township OR "planning commission" OR rezoning) when:7d

google_news.name: South and Texas
google_news.query: "data center" (Texas OR Georgia OR Louisiana OR Mississippi OR Tennessee OR Alabama OR Arkansas OR Oklahoma) when:7d

google_news.name: Mid-Atlantic and Southeast
google_news.query: "data center" (Virginia OR "North Carolina" OR "South Carolina" OR Pennsylvania OR Maryland OR "New Jersey") when:7d

google_news.name: Midwest
google_news.query: "data center" (Ohio OR Indiana OR Illinois OR Wisconsin OR Michigan OR Minnesota OR Iowa OR Missouri OR Nebraska OR Kansas) when:7d

google_news.name: West
google_news.query: "data center" (Arizona OR Nevada OR Utah OR Oregon OR Washington OR Wyoming OR "New Mexico" OR Idaho OR Colorado OR "North Dakota") when:7d
